consultas: how much does wallpaper installation cost, pricing
turnos.respuesta:
I can't give you a number — pricing comes from the team once they know the specifics. What tends to drive it most is the material you choose (a machine-printed paper and a hand-finished mural sit in very different brackets) and how much of it a pattern repeat consumes, which can be more than the wall area itself.

Is it one accent wall in the nursery or the whole room?

turnos.pregunta: Two-storey stairwell, old paper on it, probably needs removing first.
consultas: Two-storey stairwell, old paper on it, probably needs removing first.
turnos.respuesta:
That's usually the part that's hardest to judge from a description — how easily old paper comes away varies a lot, and painted-over or older layers can pull at the surface and reveal repair work nobody could see beforehand. It's the main reason a look at the wall in person tells you more than photos.

If you'd like, I can pass your details along so someone can take a look when you're ready.
